title: AlifBee — Curated MSA Audio-First Path
design: Curated rather than chronological. Choose beginner MSA episodes in prerequisite order, deduplicate concepts already mastered, and use non-AlifBee grammar/listening sources when the podcast has a gap.
completed_prior_concept_milestones: basic nominal sentences without an explicit present-tense copula

items.title: Arabic Basics for Beginners: 10 Must-Know Essentials to Start Learning
items.rule: Move quickly through already-mastered material and extract only genuinely new or deepened concepts.

items.title: How to Say Hello in Arabic: Complete Guide to Arabic Greetings
items.rule: Use primarily as spaced listening reinforcement because greetings are already learned.

items.title: 100 Common Words in Arabic
items.rule: Do not create 100 cards automatically; add only high-frequency/generative items not already known.

items.title: How to Tell the Time in Arabic: A Beginner’s Guide
6 Helpful Arabic Phrases to Say Sorry
Days of the Week in Arabic (MSA + Dialects) with Audio & Real-life Phrases
items.msa_rule: Extract MSA into the core deck; label dialect forms separately and do not merge them into MSA answers.

items.title: Basic Vocabulary to Talk about Weather and Seasons in Arabic
Arabic Root System: How Arabic Words Are Built From Root Letters
50 Easy Arabic Words for Beginners
items.rule: Select useful unknown vocabulary only; do not mass-import every word.

after_order_10: Continue curating the live AlifBee MSA podcast by prerequisite and concept gaps. Interleave LQToronto/Madina for deeper grammar and DLI GLOSS/other verified audio for later graded listening. Do not use Arabic-only immersion as beginner first exposure.
completion_protocol: On complete/finished, verify the exact episode, extract/deepen useful Arabic cards and audio-review scripts, update spaced review, then advance to the next appropriate audio item.
